sn11.14:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn11.14:1.2: There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn11.14:2.1: “Bhikkhus, once in the past in this same Rajagaha there was a poor man, a pauper, an indigent.
sn11.14:2.2: He undertook faith, virtue, learning, generosity, and wisdom in the Dhamma and Discipline proclaimed by the Tathagata.
sn11.14:2.3: Having done so, with the breakup of the body, after death, he was reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world, in the company of the Tavatiṁsa devas,
sn11.14:2.4: where he outshone the other devas in regard to beauty and glory.
sn11.14:2.5: “Thereupon the Tavatiṁsa devas found fault with this, grumbled, and complained about it, saying:
sn11.14:2.6: ‘It is wonderful indeed, sir! It is amazing indeed, sir!
sn11.14:2.7: For formerly, when this young deva was a human being, he was a poor man, a pauper, an indigent.
sn11.14:2.8: Yet with the breakup of the body, after death, he has been reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world, in the company of the Tavatiṁsa devas,
sn11.14:2.9: where he outshines the other devas in regard to beauty and glory.’
sn11.14:3.1: “Then, bhikkhus, Sakka, lord of the devas, addressed the Tavatiṁsa devas thus:
sn11.14:3.2: ‘Dear sirs, do not find fault with this young deva.
sn11.14:3.3: Formerly, when this young deva was a human being, he undertook faith, virtue, learning, generosity, and wisdom in the Dhamma and Discipline proclaimed by the Tathagata.
sn11.14:3.4: Having done so, with the breakup of the body, after death, he has been reborn in a good destination, in a heavenly world, in the company of the Tavatiṁsa devas,
sn11.14:3.5: where he outshines the other devas in regard to beauty and glory.’
sn11.14:3.6: “Then, bhikkhus, instructing the Tavatiṁsa devas, Sakka, lord of the devas, on that occasion recited these verses:
sn11.14:4.1: “‘When one has faith in the Tathagata,
sn11.14:4.3: And good conduct built on virtue,
sn11.14:4.4: Dear to the noble ones and praised;
sn11.14:5.1: “‘When one has confidence in the Saṅgha
sn11.14:5.2: And one’s view is straightened out,
sn11.14:5.3: They say that one isn’t poor;
sn11.14:5.4: One’s life is not lived in vain.
sn11.14:6.2: Remembering the Buddha’s Teaching, Should be devoted to faith and virtue,
sn11.14:6.3: To confidence and vision of the Dhamma.’”
